scope_note: A deliberately limited international source foundation. Absence from this corpus means unsupported, not legally irrelevant.

sources.source_name: Agreement on Trade-Related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights (TRIPS)
sources.excerpt: Plants and animals other than micro-organisms, and essentially biological processes for the production of plants or animals other than non-biological and microbiological processes.

verification.method: Official WTO agreement text, Article 27, paragraph 3(b)
verification.notes: Excerpt is a concise faithful extract; consult the linked full text for qualifications.

sources.source_name: WIPO Treaty on Intellectual Property, Genetic Resources and Associated Traditional Knowledge
sources.excerpt: Where the claimed invention in a patent application is based on genetic resources, each Contracting Party shall require applicants to disclose:
sources.region: Contracting Parties once treaty obligations apply

verification.method: Official WIPO Lex treaty text, Article 3.1
verification.notes: Adopted 2024-05-24. No present entry-into-force date is asserted.

sources.source_name: WIPO Treaty on Intellectual Property, Genetic Resources and Associated Traditional Knowledge
sources.excerpt: Where the claimed invention in a patent application is based on traditional knowledge associated with genetic resources, each Contracting Party shall require applicants to disclose:
sources.region: Contracting Parties once treaty obligations apply

verification.method: Official WIPO Lex treaty text, Article 3.2
verification.notes: Concise extract retains the provision's alternative when provider information is unknown or inapplicable.

sources.source_name: WIPO Treaty on Intellectual Property, Genetic Resources and Associated Traditional Knowledge
sources.excerpt: This Treaty shall enter into force three months after 15 eligible parties referred to in Article 12 have deposited their instruments of ratification or accession.

verification.method: Official WIPO Lex treaty text, Article 17
verification.notes: The corpus intentionally does not store a volatile ratification count or claim that the Treaty is in force.

sources.excerpt: The Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT) makes it possible to seek patent protection for an invention simultaneously in each of a large number of countries by filing an "international" patent application.

verification.notes: Supports the patent golden scenario; it does not imply that WIPO grants a worldwide patent.

sources.source_name: Introduction to the Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT)
sources.excerpt: Out of the PCT procedure patents can only be granted by each of the national Offices in the national phase.

verification.method: Official WIPO PCT introduction, National Phase
verification.notes: Preserves the crucial limitation that the PCT is a filing route, not a patent-granting authority.

sources.excerpt: You file a single international trademark application and pay one set of fees, in one currency, to apply for protection in multiple countries or regions simultaneously

verification.notes: Member/country counts and fee amounts are intentionally omitted because they change.

sources.section: Question 1: What is the Hague System?
sources.excerpt: The Hague System is a practical business solution to secure and manage up to 100 designs in multiple countries by filing a single international design application

verification.notes: Member/country counts and fees are intentionally omitted because they change.

sources.authoritative_body: Secretariat of the Convention on Biological Diversity
sources.excerpt: The authority to determine access to genetic resources rests with the national governments and is subject to national legislation.

verification.notes: International framework only; it does not encode any country's domestic procedure.

sources.authoritative_body: Secretariat of the Convention on Biological Diversity
sources.excerpt: Access to genetic resources shall be subject to prior informed consent of the Contracting Party providing such resources, unless otherwise determined by that Party.

verification.notes: The provision's unless-otherwise-determined qualification is retained.

sources.source_name: Nagoya Protocol on Access and Benefit-sharing
sources.authoritative_body: Secretariat of the Convention on Biological Diversity
sources.excerpt: Benefits arising from the utilization of genetic resources as well as subsequent applications and commercialization shall be shared in a fair and equitable way

verification.notes: Concise extract; country-specific implementation remains outside this record.

sources.source_name: Nagoya Protocol on Access and Benefit-sharing
sources.authoritative_body: Secretariat of the Convention on Biological Diversity
sources.excerpt: Access to genetic resources for their utilization shall be subject to the prior informed consent of the Party providing such resources that is the country of origin of such resources

verification.notes: Retains the domestic-law and unless-otherwise-determined qualifications in the linked source.
